acceptance: proposals through the gap review: the nerv step that generalises the alert poller (producer-scoped config and ledger, scope in place of roomId, night classes per producer table) for nerv:F-122 and nerv:F-101-T09; fpvbuddy:F-013-T01 and grover:F-008 only where their shape differs from the contract
